coverage_note_rotation_specific._comment: COVERAGE artifact, NOT a spin signal: rotation moves the player more than a static ordinary battery, so it triggers generic collision/throw/state functions the ordinary battery missed. All are NAMED generic gameplay functions — none is a dedicated spin routine. Noisy/run-dependent; not the criterion.

scope_residual: BOUNDED NEGATIVE, not a disproof. Establishes only that the tested battery exposed no distinct spin STATE (no undocumented mode value; the mode word has one owner) and no observed UNKNOWN player-block writer routine. Does NOT exclude a move gated on an input/context outside the tested alphabet, or a branch hidden INSIDE a named generic function (the kick's shape — a branch in player_vertical_update writing timer 0x800A657A). A07 remains an external lead pending an exact reproducible trigger or branch-level proof.
conclusion: Bounded negative supported: the tested input battery exposed no undocumented mode value or unnamed player-block writer, and all access-log events were retrieved without truncation. This is NOT a disproof: a kick-shaped branch inside a named function remains possible.
